fato_historico: 2012: At least 306 people are killed and 3,000 others injured in a pair of earthquakes near Tabriz, Iran.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to practice profound empathy today, Pisces. Just as the earth sometimes trembles and shifts, our hearts may also feel sudden tremors of transformation. It is a good time to ground yourself in kindness, offering warmth to those who feel shaken, and finding stability within your own intuitive, watery depths as you navigate the day.
frase_do_dia: Even when the ground beneath us moves, our inner light remains a steady beacon.
significado_numero: A master number representing intuition and spiritual awakening in your life path.
conselho: Consider extending a helping hand to someone who is weathering a difficult emotional storm.
